name: codex-ctx
description: Codex context helper: local history snapshots, ranked recall, Claude Code Ctx-style reports, timelines, metrics, pruning, and MCP wrappers that cache large command or file output.

interface.shortDescription: Context memory, reports, metrics, and large-output wrappers for Codex
interface.longDescription: Codex Ctx reads local Codex history, writes project snapshots, searches prior work, reports context health, builds timelines and metrics, prunes old memory/cache files, and exposes MCP tools for summarized shell/file output with cache references.
defaultPrompt: Recall what we did in this project
